lines.en: Four of us crawl in a row.
I lead; the others follow.
My shell is brighter than my kin's.
I crawl fast, segment after segment.
I scout ahead, my body sliding low.
I follow the originium sand.
I clamber over the rubble.
We hold the whole gully.
I push the sand aside to clear a path.
I lead the other three around the rocks.
I keep half a step ahead of the others.
I arc around to flank.
I stop, and the ones behind stop too.
My feet fall in a dense patter.
I slide down the slope.
I leave a trail the whole way.
I lift my head and sniff.
I turn; the line turns with me.
I lie on the sand, my kin around me.

lines.zh: 我们这一群，数量是优势。
lines.en: Numbers are our advantage.
My shell is reddish. Easy to spot.
I listen to movement in the sand.

lines.zh: 我比普通的高能源石虫更凶。
lines.en: I'm fiercer than the common ones.
Four shells stack up and block the burrow mouth.
I turn my head in a circle.
This oridesert is ours.
I wait for someone to step in.
Feed me iron and I'll be crueler.
We don't call; we feel vibrations.
An old crack runs along my shell.
You've stepped into our sand.
There's more than one of us.

lines.zh: 你低头看，我们已经围上来。
lines.en: Look down: we've already closed in.
Your boots are too thin.
I raise my head; my kin do too.
Counting us? You'll lose track.
You can't run fast on this sand.
There's something under your shadow.
We're only interested in iron.
Fight, and you fight four.

lines.zh: 裂纹从背中间裂开一截。
lines.en: A crack splits open across the middle of my back.
I shrink; my kin take my place.
That'll halt me a while.

lines.zh: 我缩进同伴让出的空当。
lines.en: I squeeze into the gap my packmates leave me.
Sand gets into the crack.
I fall back.
A joint has come loose.

lines.zh: 我退到队伍中间喘口气。
lines.en: I fall back into the middle of the pack to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我们不会因为一只受伤就散。
lines.en: One wound won't scatter us.
You hit a group, not one.

lines.zh: 铁的味道，全队都闻到了。
lines.en: The whole group smells iron.
We're crawling toward you.
That piece won't go around.
Give it to me; I'm in front.
When we scramble for it, it's chaos.

lines.zh: 你手抬高点，我们爬不上。
lines.en: Hold it higher; we can't climb.
This iron — I bite first.
A kin shoved me.
We drag the iron into the sand.
Drop the iron and we'll stop.

lines.zh: 你踩到一只，四只都动了。
lines.en: You step on one, and all four move.
We flood around your feet.
I'm kicked over and right myself.

lines.zh: 我的壳碰你的鞋，咔一声。
lines.en: My shell clicks against your boot.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们就围上来。
lines.en: You step back and we close in.
We collide with each other and don't scatter.
We churn the sand into a mess.

lines.zh: 踩我一脚，其余三只围上来。
lines.en: Step on me and the other three close in.
I'm shoved to one side.
We're used to knocks.
Any of the group can pair off.
We touch feelers, casually.
It crawls in front with me.
Our shells are much the same color.
Within the group, iron gets shared.
It guards my flank.
We sleep side by side in the sand.
At dawn the line reorders.
It crawls off first.

lines.zh: 这片沙上，总会有新的同伴。
lines.en: On this sand, there are always new companions.
I grab a piece and hold it.
My kin come to grab it too.
I press it under me and cover it.
I press the iron down into the sand to hide it.
We bite at it together.
I drag it toward the sand.
Too heavy; two of us haul it.
The pearl rolls into a crack.
I push it back out.
We keep it and eat slowly.
The group spreads and encircles it.
I raise my head first.
My kin are already on it.
We come from four sides.
It stepped on our ground.
My veins light up.
We put force into this.
You can only guard one side.
We have it. Don't let it leave.
The sand is trembling.
We move together.
This one I'm leading.
It runs ahead; the line follows.
We close from both sides.
Its prints are deep.
We stay close.
It looks back; we spread a little.
We know the trail in the sand.
Behind the rock, we go around.
One crushed, three left.
We tighten the circle.
It's panting hard.
When it stops, we strike.

lines.zh: 我们要把它围死在沟里。
lines.en: We'll pin it in the gully.

lines.zh: 我的头槌撞在它膝弯上。
lines.en: My head-butt lands behind its knee.
Four rams at once and you can't stand.
My body carries heat.
It kicks one off; three remain.
We bite the same garment.
That threw up all the sand.
I slam into its flank from the side.
I pin its hand.
My shell butts its knee.
We've slowed it down.
The four of us bore out together.
We've taken this patch of sand.
I surface first; the others follow.
Hot sand warms my shell.
Our line is formed.
I shake off a layer of sand.
This oridesert is wide open.
I smell iron far off.
We crawl down the slope together.
The wind draws the sand into a line.
My shell reddens in the sun.
First I test my footing.
The edge of my shell curls up from the heat.
I roll over on landing.
Water in my joints; I stiffen.
The blast scatters us all.
An arrow pierces the edge of my shell.
Light burns my joints and numbs them.
No iron, no strength.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我半边不动了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; half of me stops.
We fall, and keep falling.
